result.instructions: Tools for Laposta, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How many active subscribers does each of my Laposta lists have?"; "Show the open and click rates of my last five newsletters."; "Find the subscriber maartje@example.com and show what she opened recently.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Laposta data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run laposta_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run laposta_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run laposta_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. laposta_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: laposta_list_lists
tools.title: List mailing lists
tools.description: List all mailing lists of the Laposta account with member counts (active, unsubscribed, cleaned). Use the list_id in the other tools.

tools.name: laposta_get_list
tools.title: Get a mailing list
tools.description: Get one mailing list: name, state, notification addresses and member counts.

tools.name: laposta_list_fields
tools.title: List a list's fields
tools.description: List the custom fields of a mailing list (name, custom_name used as the key in custom_fields, datatype, required, options). Call this before adding or updating a member.

tools.name: laposta_list_segments
tools.title: List a list's segments
tools.description: List the segments of a mailing list (a segment id can be a campaign recipient together with its list).

tools.name: laposta_list_members
tools.title: List members of a list
tools.description: List the members (subscribers) of a mailing list, one page at a time. Filter by state, free-text search (email and field values) or label. Contains personal data: only fetch what the task needs.

state.description: Only members in this state (default: all).

search.description: Only members containing this text in the email or any text/number/choice field.

label.description: Only members with this label (by name).

order_by.description: email, signup_date, or a text field's custom_name (comma-separated for several).

limit.description: Items per page (default 25, max 100; a large page can be cut at 50,000 characters and lose its next_cursor).

cursor.description: Cursor: pass the previous reply's next_cursor unchanged, with the same filters.

tools.name: laposta_get_member
tools.title: Get a member
tools.description: Get one member of a list by member id or email address: state, signup/confirm dates and custom field values.

member.description: The member id OR the member's email address.

tools.name: laposta_get_member_history
tools.title: Get a member's event history
tools.description: The event history of one member (subscribed, confirmed, opened, clicked, bounced, unsubscribed, automations ...), newest first by default. Optionally limited to one campaign or a date range. Paged by cursor.

member.description: The member id OR the member's email address.

limit.description: Items per page (default 25, max 100; a large page can be cut at 50,000 characters and lose its next_cursor).

cursor.description: Cursor: pass the previous reply's next_cursor unchanged, with the same filters.

tools.name: laposta_list_campaigns
tools.title: List campaigns
tools.description: List the account's campaigns (name, subject, sender, recipient lists, delivery moments). Use limit/offset to page.

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: laposta_get_campaign
tools.title: Get a campaign
tools.description: Get one campaign: name, subject, preview text, sender, reply-to, recipients, delivery moments and web version URL.

tools.name: laposta_get_campaign_content
tools.title: Get a campaign's content
tools.description: Get the plain-text content of a campaign (and its import_url if it was imported). Set include_html to also get the full HTML (large).

include_html.description: Also return the HTML body (default false).

tools.name: laposta_get_campaign_history
tools.title: Get a campaign's event history
tools.description: Recipient events of one campaign (delivered, opened, clicked, bounced, unsubscribed ...), newest first by default, optionally within a date range. Paged by cursor. For totals use laposta_get_report.

limit.description: Items per page (default 25, max 100; a large page can be cut at 50,000 characters and lose its next_cursor).

cursor.description: Cursor: pass the previous reply's next_cursor unchanged, with the same filters.

tools.name: laposta_list_reports
tools.title: List campaign reports
tools.description: Result figures of all campaigns: sent, accepted, opened, clicked, bounced, unsubscribed, with ratios. Use limit/offset to page.

offset.description: Items to skip (default 0). Pass the previous reply's next_offset.

tools.name: laposta_get_report
tools.title: Get a campaign report
tools.description: Result figures of one campaign: sent, accepted, unique opens and clicks, bounces, complaints, unsubscribes and their ratios.

tools.name: laposta_add_member
tools.title: Add a member to a list
tools.description: WRITE: add one email address to a mailing list (subscribe). On a double opt-in list Laposta sends the confirmation email to that address. The address must have given consent. With upsert, an existing active member's fields are overwritten; an unsubscribed member is re-activated unless suppress_reactivation is set.

ip.description: IP address the signup came from (required by Laposta; use the signup source's address, or your own server's if it was entered by staff).

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by the field's custom_name (the variable name shown by laposta_list_fields). Multi-choice fields take an array of option values.

upsert.description: Overwrite the fields if the address is already an active member (default false: error).

suppress_reactivation.description: With upsert: do not re-activate an unsubscribed member.

suppress_email_notification.description: Do not send the list's signup notification email.

annotations.title: Add a member to a list

tools.name: laposta_update_member
tools.title: Update a member
tools.description: WRITE: change a member's custom field values and/or email address, or unsubscribe the member (state: unsubscribed). Only the fields you pass change. Re-subscribing a person is not offered here: do it in the Laposta app or with laposta_add_member upsert only when they asked for it.

member.description: The member id OR the member's email address.

email.description: A new email address for this member.

state.description: Set to unsubscribed to unsubscribe the member.

custom_fields.description: Custom field values keyed by the field's custom_name (the variable name shown by laposta_list_fields). Multi-choice fields take an array of option values.

tools.name: laposta_create_campaign
tools.title: Create a campaign draft
tools.description: WRITE: create a new regular campaign (a draft: it is NOT filled, scheduled or sent). Fill it with laposta_set_campaign_content, check it with laposta_send_test_email and send it in the Laposta app. The from_email must be an approved sender address of the account.

from_email.description: Sender email address (must be an approved sender in Laposta).

items.description: Laposta id (a short alphanumeric string, e.g. BaImMu3JZA).

list_ids.description: Recipients: list ids and optionally segment ids.

tools.name: laposta_set_campaign_content
tools.title: Set a campaign's content
tools.description: WRITE: replace a campaign's content with your HTML, or let Laposta import it from a URL (html wins if both are given). Does not send anything. The reply's report lists problems Laposta found (javascript, missing unsubscribe link, missing images).

html.description: The complete HTML of the email.

import_url.description: A public URL Laposta fetches the HTML from.

tools.name: laposta_send_test_email
tools.title: Send a campaign test email
tools.description: WRITE: send a test copy of a campaign (it must have content and not be sent yet) to ONE email address. Does not send the campaign to its recipients.

prompts.name: getting_started
prompts.title: Get started with Laposta
prompts.description: What you can do with Laposta here, with example requests to try.
